paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Financial Analyst role supporting the eReader product line at Amazon. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because the role covers the full product line, from operating plans and near-term forecasts to the financial view on future products.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At Thomson Reuters I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, and streamlined the order-to-cash process with automation, cutting the cash conversion cycle by 20%.
That maps to the operating plan, forecasts and the push to automate and simplify controllership work on your team. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
